others.name: Mr. Chun Kwok Ng
others.role: Founder, chief executive, chairman; holds shares through TechLiving Hub Solutions Corporation

lockup.summary: Directors, officers and all current shareholders, including six pre-IPO investors, agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the offering closes. The company also agreed not to issue shares in that time.

what: It rents and manages student dormitories near Hong Kong universities and refers students to education advisory services.
proceeds: It plans to use about 55% for growing its Hong Kong business, 20% for entering Southeast Asia, 5% for a dormitory management system, and 20% for working capital and general costs. Net proceeds are estimated at up to $21,976,923 at $4.00 a share.
risks: Most customers are students who use the service only once, so the company must keep finding new students every year.
The company has a short operating history, so its past growth may not predict future results.
The company relies heavily on its chief executive, Mr. Chun Kwok Ng, and has no key-person insurance on him.
All of its education referral revenue comes from one partner, Meta Academia, which can end the deal with one month's notice.
Meta Academia is a related party, so deals may not be on fair market terms, and losing this revenue would be hard to replace.
